alex: Thanks for coming to today's AH. Posting quick follow-up thread for clarifications, links, and owners.

rachel: Dedicated GA timeline clarification: aiming for 2026-10-15. Milestones: feature freeze 2026-09-10, compliance sign-off 2026-09-30. I'll upload the timeline RFC. :calendar: 

mia: Who owns 32k-context tuning? Need runtime + applied-ML pairing.

dan: I'll lead runtime. Creating INF-3281 and tagging @mia.

tyler: Rollout checklist -> I'll open a PR in product repo today and paste the link here when ready.

olivia: Sales asked for a short plain-language FAQ on model pinning vs automatic routing. I can draft a one-pager.
sam: Pricing ask: the slide used averaged batching and hid burst costs. Product+finance should give two worked examples (50 RPS app, 2k RPS app).
rachel: Agree. Finance will draft examples; @sam please add your demo profile to INF-3410.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Slides + recording -> https://redwood.example.com/ah/2026-03-23

mia: Captured actions:
- Dedicated GA timeline: rachel (owner) - due 2026-09-30
- Rollout checklist PR: tyler - due today EOD
- 32k tuning RFC + plan: dan + mia - INF-3281 - due 2026-04-06
- Model pinning FAQ: olivia draft + tyler review - due 2026-03-30
- Pricing worked examples: rachel + finance - due 2026-04-13
- Customer canary guide: alex + eng-sre - draft due 2026-04-06

alex: Request: anyone who heard a roadmap ask, please file a 1-2 line card on the roadmap board labelled AH-ask (customer + impact). I'll create a template card.

tyler: I'll create the template and broadcast.
olivia: Security question follow-up: will HSM be available at GA for Private?
rachel: Not at GA. GA supports cloud KMS only (AWS/GCP). HSM targeted for Private beta post-GA.
dan: Reminder: kernel optimization spike tomorrow 10am to test a fused-attention op. Join if you want perf numbers.
mia: I'm in.
alex: Thanks all 97 if you want added as an owner or see a missing action, reply here. I'll post a follow-up doc with RFC/ticket links tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
